from pathlib import Path

path = Path('tinydb/utils.py')
source = path.read_text()
old_doc = '''    This is implemented using an ``OrderedDict``. On every access the accessed
    entry is moved to the front by re-inserting it into the ``OrderedDict``.
    When adding an entry and the cache size is exceeded, the last entry will
    be discarded.
'''
new_doc = '''    This is implemented using an ``OrderedDict``. On every read or write the
    entry is moved to the end of the ``OrderedDict``. When adding an entry
    exceeds the cache size, the first entry (the least recently used one)
    will be discarded.
'''
old_set = '''    def set(self, key: K, value: V):
        if self.cache.get(key):
            self.cache[key] = value

            # Check, if the cache is full and we have to remove old items
            # If the queue is of unlimited size, self.capacity is NaN and
            # x > NaN is always False in Python and the cache won't be cleared.
            if self.capacity is not None and self.length > self.capacity:
                self.cache.popitem(last=False)
        else:
            self.cache[key] = value
            self.cache.move_to_end(key, last=True)

class FrozenDict(dict):
'''
new_set = '''    def set(self, key: K, value: V):
        self.cache[key] = value
        self.cache.move_to_end(key, last=True)

        # Evict the least recently used item if the cache is over capacity.
        # A capacity of None means the cache is unlimited.
        if self.capacity is not None and self.length > self.capacity:
            self.cache.popitem(last=False)


class FrozenDict(dict):
'''
assert source.count(old_doc) == 1
assert source.count(old_set) == 1
path.write_text(source.replace(old_doc, new_doc).replace(old_set, new_set))

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("capacity", [0, 1, 3, None])
+def test_lru_cache_capacity(capacity):
+    cache = LRUCache(capacity=capacity)
+    for key in range(5):
+        cache[key] = key
+        start = 0 if capacity is None else max(0, key + 1 - capacity)
+        assert cache.lru == list(range(start, key + 1))
+        assert len(cache) == len(cache.lru)

+    if cache:

+        expected_order = cache.lru[1:] + [oldest]
+        cache[oldest] = 0
+        assert cache.lru == expected_order
+        assert cache[oldest] == 0
